issues.description: Frozen header is Macroeconomic Information Acquisition around Earnings Clusters (DOI 10.1111/1475-679X.70020), while the supplied README and online appendix title the compensation peer-group network study. Preserve the frozen header and assess these actual contents; resolve package-to-paper attribution before attaching results.

The complete workflow spans SAS, Stata, Python and manual UCINET/GUI stages. Mandatory author-prepared data, interval links, several producer/handoff contracts, software checks and native figure-project inputs remain unresolved; no compatible analysis-only bypass is established.

SAS producers create WORK.hopping19, WORK.rpe3, WORK.tournament_final and WORK.SUMMARY. Table 1B and its producer establish that WORK.SUMMARY is the same-data summary handoff; only persistence/path setup remains. Hopping and RPE inherited-field/sample contracts, and the tournament target-field mapping, remain specifically unresolved.

Pay-for-luck's prepared input contract requires SIC, NAICS and FYRC; its source reads ccmfunda_0428 and its native-to-analysis mappings remain unresolved. Separately, peer selection consumes b.sic/c.sic from COMP.FUNDA at matched FYEAR=a.FYEAR-1 and compares floor(sic/100). The catalog lists SICH/NAICSH as historical labels and FYR, but this metadata is not proof that physical SIC is absent or that SICH is equivalent. CCMXPF_LINKTABLE separately supplies LPERMNO/link dates; do not assume aliases.
Source requires IBES.CIBESLNK ticker/GVKEY/FDATE/LDATE intervals; readable IBCRSPHIST has TICKER/PERMNO/NCUSIP/SDATE/EDATE/SCORE and is not a substitute.
hopping.sas contains an external FF48 classification macro include not registered as an inspected source. Public French FF48 returns are a separate product and do not replace the include.

Figure 2.twbx and Figure 3A/3B.gephi appear in the frozen package inventory as kind=other, but their mixed native contents are not registered as work_item.sources. This is a bounded inspection-format limitation, not evidence that author code or a local installation is absent; embedded data, formulas, links, refresh and output details remain unknown.

Local BoardEx summary/composition records are readable positive raw data but do not directly provide the required CUSIP6/year board metrics; the BoardEx crosswalk and metric construction are not supplied.
